div.head: Af El. 40
div.ab: Leases monnes word ne recce ðu þæs to gehiranne, ne his domas ne geðafa þu, ne nane gewitnesse æfter him ne saga ðu.
Leases monnes word ne rec ðu no þæs to gehieranne, ne his domas ne geðafa ðu, ne nane gewitnesse æfter him ne saga ðu.
Non suscipies uocem mendacii nec iunges manum tuam, ut pro impio dicas falsum testimonium.
Leases monnes word ne rec ðu no þæs to gehieranne, ne his domas ne geðafa ðu, ne nane gewitnesse æfter him ne saga ðu.
You will not consider obeying the word of a dishonest man, nor will you consent to his judgments, nor will you repeat any of his testimony.
Do not thou heed the word of the false man, to obey therefore, nor consent to his judgments, nor say any witness after him.
Falschen Mannes Wort beachte du nicht, um darauf zu horchen, noch seine Urtheile billige du, und sage du kein Zeugniss ihm [folgend] nach.
Do not heed a false man’s word so as to listen to it, nor approve his judgments, and do not speak any testimony after him [following him].
div.note: This and the next clause are from Exodus xxiii. 1, 2.
